name: Ahrefs
tagline: Ahrefs is a comprehensive SEO toolset covering backlink analysis, keyword research, site auditing, rank tracking, and content gap analysis. Its crawler indexes the web continuously, giving SEOs near-real-time data on competitor link profiles and organic rankings. It's widely regarded as the most extensive backlink database in the industry.
